nodes.question: How do shrub and fast-growing grass affect ground-foraging birds?
nodes.answer: Shrub and fast-growing grass reduce access to food for ground-foraging birds.
nodes.paragraph: Vegetation development, which generally follows snowmelt in Alpine environments, drives the abundance of food resources and also their accessibility (Brambilla et al. 2017; Resano-Mayor et al. 2019; Barras et al. 2020; M ller et al. 2023). For ground-foraging birds, shrub and fast-growing grass reduce access to food. On the other hand, short swards and bare ground improve accessi- bility (Schaub et al. 2010; Tagmann-loset et al. 2012; M ller et al. 2023). Social factors, such as intra-specific competi- tion, as well as predation, often influence nest site selection and breeding success (Lack 1968; Martin 1993).
